column1: # comment: Gender alignments — gender-identity values to Homosaurus and GSSO (the authoritative LGBTQ+ / sex-gender vocabularies) and the gender-carrying property to schema.org, FOAF and Wikidata (all LOSSY — they conflate sex and gender, which GMEOW keeps rigorously apart). Only identifiers VERIFIED against the source vocabularies are mapped; the value vocab is OPEN, so additional values extend this file as their IDs are curated. The reified, self-asserted, co-equal gmeow:IdentityFacet machinery (gmeow:hasGenderIdentity/genderValue, gmeow:selfAsserted, displayable suppression of a superseded label) is CANONICAL — no maintained external RDF vocabulary models it faithfully. sexAssignedAtBirth is a recorded administrative datum, mapped (loosely) to Wikidata P21 and FHIR administrative gender; documentary sex on records uses external gedcom:sex directly.
